topic: Complex Declaration Parsing and Type-Name Shadowing in C
explanation: In advanced C programming, complex declarations can lead to subtle bugs and confusion, especially when variable names shadow type names or when declarations involve intricate syntax. Understanding how C parses declarations—particularly when variable names coincide with type names—and how to interpret such code is crucial for writing clear, maintainable, and bug-free code. Mastery of declaration precedence and shadowing helps prevent misinterpretation of sizeof, linkage, and storage class behaviors in complex scenarios.
